drafts.x_post: AAOI ($AAOI): Applied Optoelectronics makes the physical hardware that turns electricity into light — lasers and optical transceivers — so data centers, telecom networks, and cable systems can move data at high speed over fiber. Dead Simple Score: 83/100 · Silver. Status: Watchlist.
video_talking_points: Applied Optoelectronics makes the physical hardware that turns electricity into light — lasers and optical transceivers — so data centers, telecom networks, and cable systems can move data at high speed over fiber.

Watchlist. The growth is real, but the mechanism that would justify the current price — margin expansion from vertical integration — is moving in the wrong direction, and the cash-burn picture may be worse than the reported figure suggests. Two consecutive quarters of gross margin above 33% paired with stabilized (not falling) net cash would move this toward open; a dilutive raise or continued sub-30% margin would move it toward close.
Moat: Vertical integration is the entire thesis and remains unconfirmed; the one proof point (rising gross margin) is moving backward, not forward.
Risk: TTM free cash flow as reported (-$413.3M) doesn't reconcile with TTM OCF minus capex (-$621.3M) — every other period in the data reconciles exactly except this one.
